methodology.scene: production route, sounding generated pattern, Config Global panel open
methodology.frameCallbackScope: rAF intervals cover browser-delivered animation opportunities for the whole page, including the delay from sample start to the first callback; they are not JS callback duration or proof of displayed hardware frames
methodology.uiBeatCadenceScope: a bounded MutationObserver records distinct inline scale changes for every visible bound consumer; each on-window target must avoid idle gaps longer than two beat periods with a 2000ms floor, including the sample boundaries
methodology.cdpTraceScope: a separate diagnostic trace follows each untraced frame-callback window; selected raw presentation/drop events and full event-name counts are retained, event availability varies by browser build, and tracing does not prove display scanout
methodology.longAnimationFrameScope: browser Long Animation Frame entries include main-thread script/render attribution where supported

limitations: Physical displayed frames require the operator's named-device/native-window observation; CDP cannot independently prove panel scanout.
requestAnimationFrame timestamps can reveal foreground page pacing but do not directly measure compositor-to-display presentation.
The cadence guard's MutationObserver and per-frame retained-node connection, binding, state, and visibility checks add main-thread and layout observation work that can affect measured pacing.
A software-rendered or emulated capture cannot close the physical-device capacity gate.

traceArtifact.content: gzip-compressed selected raw CDP presentation/drop events; full event-name counts remain inline
